Title: Invalid catalog query parameters require explicit validation
Steps: Open the catalog with boundary query values such as pageId=0 or invalid filter IDs.
Expected: Application handles invalid parameters without 5xx errors and shows a safe fallback.
Comment: This is tracked as a validation risk, not as a confirmed production defect.

Title: Basket persistence should be verified across anonymous-to-authenticated transition
Steps: Add an item anonymously, then log in as demo-user and check basket state.
Expected: Basket behavior is consistent and documented.
Comment: Important integration point between Basket and Identity.

Title: Basket quantity boundary values should be tested
Steps: Try quantity values 0, negative values, large values and non-numeric input where applicable.
Expected: Invalid quantity values are rejected or normalized safely.
Comment: Boundary checks are critical for totals and checkout.

Title: Checkout flow has high integration risk
Steps: Run a full flow: catalog -> basket -> login -> checkout -> order history.
Expected: Order is created and visible in order history.
Comment: This scenario crosses several modules and should be prioritized.

Title: Admin UI depends on PublicApi availability
Steps: Run Web without PublicApi, then open /admin as admin user.
Expected: Application should fail gracefully or show clear error handling.
Comment: Original README notes that admin relies on PublicApi.

Title: Postman collection covers smoke checks only
Expected: Smoke tests are documented as limited and complemented by manual E2E checks.
Actual: Covered by documentation, automation can be expanded later.
Comment: Future improvement: add Playwright or Selenium E2E tests.

Title: Error pages should not expose stack traces
Steps: Open invalid URLs and trigger invalid input scenarios in production-like mode.
Expected: User sees safe error page without stack trace or internal paths.

Title: User input should be checked for HTML/JS encoding
Steps: Enter HTML/JS-like payloads into available fields.
Expected: Input is encoded or rejected and never executed as script.
Comment: Do not mark as XSS unless reproduced with evidence.

Title: Cold start performance should be separated from steady-state performance
Steps: Measure first request after start and repeated requests after warm-up.
Expected: Report separates cold start from normal response time.

Title: Docker and local run use different base URLs
Steps: Run via Docker and via dotnet launch profile.
Expected: Postman environment is updated to actual base URL before testing.
Comment: Common source of false failed tests.
